records.retainedText: First-party investigation 1.2 (Survey about classmates): Teacher assigns a group three investigation prompts, one classwide numerical (e.g. typical journey minutes), one categorical (e.g. preferred school lunch), and one non-statistical fixed fact (e.g. number of windows in this room). Write a fourth statistical question independently. For EACH of the four prompts write a survey item suitable for an individual respondent. With classroom permission ask all four items to 15 classmates; record anonymous responses without names or identifying information; then return to the group, summarize each question's responses in one or two sentences, and explain what responses 1, 2 and 3 have in common and whether prompt 4 belongs with 1, 2 or 3. Keep data for the subsequent graphing lesson. If no authorized data collection occurs, use explicitly fictional data only and mark the authentic 15-classmate task NOT COMPLETED.
